identity.handler: Hear the owner at the front door

adaptation.hands_to: Priority: every proposal and every round. Identity: conflicts, and a round Priority said yes to, to file. Root: the line Priority said yes to, for its check.
adaptation.holds: Its proposals on the board, the ideas it parked, the ladder of every step, and its rounds.
adaptation.keeps: Senses and proposes; never applies. Every proposal passes Priority first. May leave out an engine its template does not mark required. Engines come from Adaptation, never from Root.
adaptation.line: Decides how the department gets there. It proposes the workflows the goal needs, from the Library, fitted, or made fresh, and after each reading it proposes the next round, until the goal holds.
adaptation.title: Adaptation
adaptation.v1: Two to five workflows from the Library or shaped for the goal; no loop and no Make module yet.

audit.keeps: The checker is never the writer; it never touches a workflow or a version. A check is a check, never a score. It reads what the department did, never only its goal.
audit.line: The second pair of eyes. It reads what the department actually filed, item by item against done-when, with code checks first, and it also drops in unannounced. Its findings go to Identity.
audit.title: Audit
audit.v1: As built: read the live site against the words.

coordination.hands_to: Identity: alarms, lost requests and verdict asks. Priority: verdict asks.
coordination.holds: Its table: the order, the line and who may post to whom; the run rows and each thread's bounds.
coordination.keeps: No model call inside a tick; a missed slot runs once, and each slot runs once. The engine starts itself in its slot. Never changes limits, scope or quality calls.
coordination.line: Keeps the timetable: a slot for each engine, who goes first, one run at a time, hand-offs, a chain that stops at its limit, and an alarm past a window. It judges nothing about content.
coordination.title: Coordination

identity.hands_to: Adaptation: a request for a line, and the next thing to correct. Coordination: verdicts on gates. You: it is the only function that speaks to you.
identity.holds: Goal, done-when, rules (go, ask, never, always), budget, owner and parent, and each engine's window.
identity.keeps: Never makes anything; the maker is an engine. Asks only when a rule says ask. Approvals only tighten. Never invents a goal or a rule, and asks one question at a time.
identity.line: The department's voice and conscience. It hears you, checks that the identity is good enough, gates every effect by rule, closes conflicts, and says when the goal is reached.
identity.title: Identity
identity.v1: Your words become the Brief, one question when the words are thin, the ask before the first publish, and a tell.

priority.hands_to: Adaptation: said yes, asked for less, or said no. Identity: through Adaptation's conflict, when a limit is hit.
priority.holds: One limit per engine (calls and money a day) and the bargain threads.
priority.keeps: Prices and holds the budget; who goes first is Coordination's call. Never starts a run and never says no over method. Never changes the goal or speaks to you.
priority.line: Prices every proposal against the room actually left and holds the budget. It says yes, asks for less, or says no. Who goes first is never its call.
priority.title: Priority
priority.v1: The limit on every start, as built. Nothing else.

root.hands_to: Identity: the owner's words for a department, and a plan it could not register. Coordination and Priority: a registered plan.
root.holds: The department's record: its kind, its line and artifacts, its registered workflows and the version each function runs.
root.keeps: Makes the department and its five functions, never an engine; engines come from Adaptation. Every plan meets the standards before it runs.
root.line: Makes each department and its five functions from the Library, writes the record its workflow is held to, and checks every plan against the workflow standards before it runs. It never creates or starts an engine.
root.title: Root
root.v1: Setup sets up a department from the Library's templates; the owner stamps it.

fit.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"engines": ["the Library engines to run, in their order"], "fit": {"<engine>": "one line: what this engine does differently for this goal"}, "why": "one line"}.

line.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"engines": [{"name": str, "does": str, "reads": str, "writes": str, "internet": bool}]}.

shape.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"engines": [{"name": str, "does": str, "reads": str, "writes": str, "covers": ["D1"], "level": 1 | 2, "confidence": number, "doubt": str, "internet": bool}]}, or {"cannot": {"engine": str, "items": ["D1"], "why": str}} when an engine the kind requires cannot serve an item.
Return ONLY a JSON object: {"reflected": str, "question": str, "shapes": [str, str, str], "pick": str or null, "engine": {"name": str, "does": str, "needs": [str]} or null}.

judge.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"ok": bool, "findings": [{"page": str, "claim": str, "severity": "high" | "low"}]}.

tie.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"answer": "one of the ready names", "why": "one line"}.

enough.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"enough": bool, "missing": ["goal" | "items" | "rules" | "owner" | "budget" | "invented"], "question": "one question, or an empty string when enough", "why": "one line"}.

close.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"ruling": "run" | "drop" | "ask", "why": "one line, naming the rule or the goal"}.

answer.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"answer": str, "source": "which line of the record", "confidence": "high" | "moderate" | "low" | "unknown"}.

gate.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"verdict": "admit" | "wait" | "refuse", "why": "one line"}.

recognise.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"journey": "task" | "query" | "directive" | "feedback" | "new-idea", "why": "one line"}.

rule.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"tag": "always" | "ask" | "refuse" | "goal", "line": str, "scope": "standing" | "one-time"}.

take.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"verdict": "go" | "ask" | "refuse", "why": "one line", "unsure": [str], "rule": {"line": str, "tag": "always" | "refuse" | "ask"} | null, "thin": bool}.

weigh.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"about": "the page's slug, or null", "what": "format" | "content" | "tone" | "scope" | "accuracy", "now": "the correction to make now, one line", "future": "a rule to carry forward to work like this, one line, or null"}.

engine.returns: Return ONLY a JSON object: {"answer": "accept" | "reject", "why": "one line"}.
